crossRefs.note: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup…
In the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, I picked up the wine, and…

translations.web: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;
translations.bsb: Pharaoh restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again placed the cup in Pharaoh’s hand.
translations.kjv: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:
